description: This file defines the RequestService class which encapsulates business logic for managing service requests, including creation, retrieval, listing, status updates with transition validation, and fetching history. It interacts with the Repository for data operations and uses custom error classes.

classes.name: RequestService
classes.description: Encapsulates business logic for service requests, handling creation, retrieval, listing, status updates (with transition validation), and history retrieval.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut create(self, payload: ServiceRequestCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new service request with initial status 'new' and logs an entry in the history.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut get(self, request_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific request by ID or raises NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ServiceRequestListItem],int] list( self, status: Optional[StatusEnum], q: Optional[str], page: int, page_size: int )
methods.description: Lists requests with optional filtering by status and query, supporting pagination.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut update_status( self, request_id: str, new_status: StatusEnum, note: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Updates the status of a request, ensuring valid transition rules, and raises errors if invalid or request not found.

methods.name: ServiceRequestHistoryResponse history(self, request_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the chronological history of a given request, raising error if request not found.

methods.name: bool _is_valid_transition(old: StatusEnum, new: StatusEnum)
methods.description: Checks if transitioning from old status to new status is allowed based on defined rules.

ctags.name: list
ctags.signature: ( self, status: Optional[StatusEnum], q: Optional[str], page: int, page_size: int )

ctags.name: update_status
ctags.signature: ( self, request_id: str, new_status: StatusEnum, note: Optional[str] )
